study.question: On the under_normalized host with the norm seed and lifecycle v2, does the graft's germination timing (graft_epoch 0-5) or the training horizon (10 vs 20 epochs) change how much of static capacity's gain the graft captures?
study.stop_condition_owner_signed: PDR-0054: if neither timing nor horizon changes the outcome (capture stays flat and static still wins), the ladder stops at rung 4; location or a different host proceeds only through a new owner decision.
based_on: graft-capture-v2-norm (rung 3): graft at epoch 2 captures 0.60 [0.51, 0.72] of static's gain; graft - static +0.057 [+0.028, +0.086]; the gap narrowed toward the horizon (descriptive). Seen.

Two pilots (seeds 9301-9324, 24 seeds x 6 cells, 144 runs): read for spread and stability only. 0 graft divergences in any cell; 1 static divergence. Pooled sd: timing (T0 - T5) 0.070 (95% UCL 0.093), horizon (gap20 - gap10) 0.206 (UCL 0.276), per-cell graft - static about 0.15 (UCL about 0.20).

units.definition: one training seed; every cell of a seed shares initialisation and the minibatch order prefix, and runs on one GPU
units.population_note: Inference covers training randomness on one fixed data sample (data_seed 20261004), the under_normalized host and the norm seed.

endpoint.metric: development cross-entropy (nats) over all 5,000 dev examples, mean over the last 3 epochs of each cell's horizon (7-9 at 10 epochs, 17-19 at 20)

reading_probabilities.method: 300 simulated 384-seed studies per row through the committed timing_study.evaluate (seed random effect shared across the 10-epoch cells, iid run noise, independent 20-epoch noise; sds from the pooled pilot at point and 95% UCL). timing = T0 - T5 effect on graft late CE; horizon = change in graft - static at 20 vs 10 epochs.

predictions.expected_reading: lever_found, if grafting earlier captures more (T0 nearer static) or static's lead shrinks with training; flat_stop if neither. The pilots were not read for means, so no direction is predicted from them; rung 3's narrowing gap is the only (descriptive) hint.
predictions.would_surprise: graft_unstable (early grafts spend six epochs fully coupled, the regime where static diverges, but 0/48 pilot T0/T1 grafts diverged), instrument_failure, or a replay mismatch.

disclosures: Rung 3 numbers were seen; pilots were read for spread and stability only (sd, divergence counts, replay), never for cell means or contrasts.
n = 384 is chosen so a truly flat world reaches flat_stop with probability >= 0.9 at the pooled pilot's 95% UCL sd; compute is not a constraint (owner, 2026-10-09).

H20 is not 'T2 continued': CommonFuture draws all permutations, then crops, then flips, so H20 shares T2's minibatch order prefix but not its augmentations. The horizon contrast is paired by seed (same initialisation), with that extra noise declared.

The timing contrast uses the endpoints T0 and T5; T5 germinates at epoch 5 and is fully coupled only at epoch 9, so its late window is partly in blending. The per-seed slope over the 10-epoch cells is reported as a secondary, never gating.
Static and no growth do not depend on graft timing: their records must replay bitwise across the 10-epoch cells (a free instrument check; a mismatch reads instrument_failure).

Execution profile: GPU, Academy-exact per SKU (2x RTX 4060 Ti), one process per GPU, every cell of a seed on one device, units trained and analysed from one immutable snapshot; data identity pinned and checked at launch.
